title: GradingDocument
description: The segmented document a task is read against, stored DENORMALISED on every task: a read must be reproducible against exactly what the reader saw, independent of any later re-ingest of the corpus (docs/plans/grading-ui.md §3.1). Units are the structural units the labels are anchored to (abstract, sections); sentences are numbered within a unit so a span can be addressed as (unit, first, last) and highlighted by sentence. The UI renders every sentence as a text node — never as HTML.

doc_id.description: The corpus document id (e.g. a PMC id). Informational: nothing is fetched by it.

title.description: Document title, shown above the units.

units.description: Structural units in reading order. `index` is the value a span's `unit` refers to; it is the position in this array and MUST equal it.

index.description: 0-based unit index; equals the unit's position in `units`.

title.description: The unit's heading (`Abstract`, `Methods`, …). Empty string when the unit has none.

sentences.description: The unit's sentences in order. `i` is the value a span's `first_sentence`/`last_sentence` refer to; it is the position in this array and MUST equal it.

i.description: 0-based sentence index within its unit; equals the position in `sentences`.

text.description: The sentence text, verbatim from the segmenter.
